title: FarcasterFrameEvent
description: An interaction event from a BibleFi Farcaster Frame. BibleFi is deployed as a native Base App and Farcaster mini-app. Frame events capture user interactions with scripture views, tithing flows, DeFi strategy entries, and church discovery within Farcaster casts.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this frame event (UUID v4). NOTE: format:uuid is an assertion in validators that enforce formats (e.g. Ajv with ajv-formats); treat as annotation-only in validators that do not.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the FarcasterFrameEvent schema used. Must be 1.x.x for documents validated against this schema ($id v1).

fid.description: Farcaster ID (FID) of the interacting user. FIDs are assigned by the Farcaster protocol.

username.description: Farcaster username of the interacting user (without @).

custody_address.description: Farcaster custody address for this FID.

verified_address.description: Primary verified Ethereum address linked to this Farcaster account.

frame_action.description: Action taken within the BibleFi Farcaster Frame.

frame_uri.description: URI of the BibleFi Farcaster Frame that triggered this event. NOTE: format:uri is an assertion in validators that enforce formats; treat as annotation-only in validators that do not. Ensure frame_uri does not embed user-specific tokens or secrets in query parameters before logging or persisting.

cast_hash.description: Hash of the Farcaster cast containing this frame. Must not be empty.

channel_id.description: Farcaster channel where the frame was cast (e.g. /biblefi, /faith, /christianity, /defi).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the frame interaction occurred.

button_index.description: Farcaster Frame button index (1–4) that was clicked, if applicable.

input_text.description: Text input submitted from the frame, if applicable.

state.description: Serialized frame state passed back with this interaction.

transaction_id.description: BibleFi transaction record ID (UUID v4) for frame actions that initiate a tracked on-chain transaction.

connected_wallet.description: Wallet connected via Farcaster frame authentication (Base chain).

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for transaction-type frame actions. Base mainnet = 8453.

biblefi_action.description: BibleFi-specific action metadata linking this frame event to BibleFi protocol objects.

action_type.description: The type of BibleFi action performed within the frame.

tithe_transaction_id.description: Links to a tithe_transaction on completion (UUID v4).

amount_wei.description: Transaction amount in wei for mint/tithe/stake actions (uint256 as string).

estimated_gas_wei.description: Estimated gas cost in wei on Base chain (uint256 as string).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.
